title: Mastering Chess and Shogi by Self-Play with AlphaZero
description: Single algorithm mastered Chess, Shogi, and Go from scratch using only self-play — no human data. Tabula rasa learning via self-play is sufficient for superhuman performance. Generalized AlphaGo.
authors: Silver, Hubert, Schrittwieser, Antonoglou, Lai, Guez, Lanctot, et al.
